snippet.title: SimsalaGrimm™ – The Chaos Crystal | Game for Switch, PlayStation 5 & PC | Official video
snippet.description:
👑 The fairy-tale world of Simsala has been turned upside down!

Yoyo and Doc Croc need your help: Wizard Malafix’s mysterious Chaos Crystal has thrown everything into disarray – and only you can save the kingdom of King Euphorius and Princess Yolinde from chaos!

Dive into a magical adventure with fairy-tale heroes Yoyo and Doc Croc, experience an exciting new story, solve challenging hidden-object puzzles and mini-games, and restore order to the kingdom. Find additional collectibles and exchange the stars you earn for beautiful cards featuring characters from the SimsalaGrimm TV series, loved by children and adults alike.

Magical fun for the whole family!

🏰 More than 20 enchanting locations – Join Yoyo and Doc Croc on their journey and help them find the hidden objects.
🧩 6 colourful mini-games – Solve tricky puzzles, riddles and memory games.
🃏 More than 100 collectible cards – Collect your favourite characters and even play a game of Quartets!
🌟 Fairy-tale fun – Discover an imaginative world full of surprises that you can enjoy again and again.

BUY HERE: 
🎮 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/SimsalaGrimm-The-Chaos-Crystal-3217642.html
🎮 PlayStation Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10016531
🎮 PC: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4356280/SimsalaGrimm__The_Chaos_Crystal/
